texto: For something that didn't happen: **Si tu avais écouté, tu aurais réussi** (if you had heard, you would have approved).
First goes «si» + plus-that -parfait (avais écouté), then conditionnel passé (aurais réussi).
**J'aurais dû étudier** (should have studied) and **J'aurais pu éviter le problème** (could have avoided the problem) talk about what happened and cannot be changed.

frases.fr: Si tu avais écouté, tu aurais réussi !
frases.en: If you'd listened, you'd have passed!
It's true, I should have studied.

frases.fr: Tu aurais pu éviter le problème.
frases.en: You could have avoided the problem.
analisis: You could have avoided (hypothetical past capacity)

bloques.pregunta: In this unreal condition of the past, what time goes after «si»?

opciones.explicacion: Unreal hypothesis of the past: if + plus-that-parfait.
In a conditional subordinate with «si», plus- that-parfait is used here.
That time is not that of this sentence.

bloques.pregunta: What does «If you had studied, you would have approved.» mean?

opciones.texto: Si tu avais étudié, tu aurais réussi.
Si tu avais étudié, tu réussis.
opciones.explicacion: After the «si» plus-that-parfait, the other part is conditionnel passé.

bloques.frase: Si tu avais écouté, tu ___ réussi.
Si tu avais écouté, tu aurais réussi.

opciones.texto: If you'd listened, you'd have passed.
It's true, I should have studied.

bloques.pregunta: What does «j'aurais évité le problème» mean?

opciones.texto: I would have avoided the problem.

bloques.pregunta: What is the grammatical structure to express an unreal condition in the past?

opciones.texto: «Si» + plus-que-parfait en la subordinada, y «conditionnel passé» en la principal.
opciones.explicacion: For example: «Si tu avais étudié, tu aurais réussi».

opciones.texto: «Si» + conditionnel passé en la subordinada, y «plus-que-parfait» en la principal.
opciones.explicacion: In French the conditional is never placed immediately after «si».

opciones.texto: «Si» + imparfait en la subordinada, y «futur simple» en la principal.
opciones.explicacion: This combination is incorrect and blends present hypothesis with future.

frases.fr: Thomas a raté une question parce qu'il n'a pas relu la consigne.
frases.es: Thomas falló una pregunta porque no volvió a leer la instrucción.
frases.en: Thomas failed a question because he never read the instruction again.
analisis: because he didn't read again (I passed negative composé)

frases.fr: S'il avait pris son temps, il aurait évité cette erreur.
frases.es: Si se hubiera tomado su tiempo, habría evitado ese error.
frases.en: If he had taken his time, he would have avoided that mistake.
analisis: if you had taken your time (if + plus-that-parfait)

frases.fr: Il aurait pu demander une explication, à condition de rester calme.
frases.es: Podría haber pedido una explicación, con la condición de mantener la calma.
frases.en: I could have asked for an explanation, on condition that you stay calm.
analisis: could have asked (conditionnel passé de pouvoir + infinitive)
with the condition of maintaining calm (same subject: infinitive)

frases.fr: Il réessaiera demain, sauf s'il a un autre rendez-vous.
frases.es: Volverá a intentarlo mañana, salvo que tenga otra cita.
frases.en: He'll try again tomorrow, unless he has another date.
analisis: except if you have (sauf if applicable)

bloques.pregunta: What would Thomas have avoided if he had taken his time?

opciones.explicacion: The date just shows up at the end.
The text does not mention a teacher.

bloques.pregunta: In what condition could he have asked for an explanation?

opciones.explicacion: That doesn't appear as a condition.
The date is an exception to try again.

intro: Last step: the unreal hypothesis of the past, what it could be and was not.
